meta.title: Demonology evidence types data

sources.label: Techwiser - Roblox Demonology All Evidence Guide
allthings.how - Demonology Evidence Types And How To Confirm

uncertainFacts: Per-difficulty Prints fade timing is described qualitatively on Fandom (varies by difficulty) but exact durations are not given; card states the behavior, not a number.
Wither wilt timing is explicitly random per Fandom; no threshold is claimed.

items.name: EMF Level 5
items.howToConfirm: Hold the EMF Reader near the ghost while it interacts with objects, manifests, or starts a hunt, and watch the meter climb through its lights.
items.confirmTell: The final red light (Level 5) lights up and a high-pitched beep plays. Lower readings on their own do not count.
items.cardSummary: EMF Level 5 is only confirmed when the EMF Reader hits its top red light during ghost activity. Anything below Level 5 is not this evidence.
items.verificationNote: Fandom V1.10.0 Evidence page: EMF Reader must reach Level 5 (final red light) plus beep.

items.name: Spirit Box
items.howToConfirm: Stand in the room with the ghost present and the lights off, then use the Spirit Box and ask it questions.
items.confirmTell: The ghost replies audibly and/or shows a red caption at the bottom of the screen. A Plushie can force a response when it starts levitating.
items.cardSummary: Spirit Box needs the ghost in the room with lights off. A spoken answer or red on-screen caption confirms it; the Plushie can guarantee a reply.
items.verificationNote: Fandom V1.10.0: lights off, ghost present, response audible or red caption; Plushie guarantees a reply when levitating.

items.name: Freezing Temperatures
items.howToConfirm: Carry a Thermometer into the ghost's room and let the reading settle, or watch the room for cold visual cues.
items.confirmTell: The Thermometer reads below 0 degrees C / 32 degrees F. Visible breath, floor fog, and frosted windows also count.
items.cardSummary: Freezing Temperatures is confirmed when the Thermometer drops below freezing, or by cold cues like breath, floor fog, and frosted windows.
items.gotcha: A brief dip that rises again quickly is usually not this evidence; do not confuse breath cues with a ghost mist event.
items.verificationNote: Fandom V1.10.0: below 0C/32F confirms; rapid dip-and-rise is unlikely to be the evidence; breath/fog/frosted windows also count.

items.name: Ghost Orb
items.howToConfirm: Point a Video Camera at the ghost room, or view the room through the Video Monitor or a teammate's Head-Mounted Camera.
items.confirmTell: A floating orb appears on camera in the ghost room. In Nightmare it drifts to the new room when the ghost room changes.
items.cardSummary: Ghost Orb only shows up on camera. Watch the ghost room through a Video Camera, the Video Monitor, or a Head-Mounted Camera.
items.gotcha: Skinwalkers can fake Ghost Orb, so confirm the other two evidences before locking it in.
items.verificationNote: Fandom V1.10.0: viewable via Video Camera / Video Monitor / Head-Mounted Camera; Skinwalker can mimic; orb travels on Nightmare room change.

items.name: Prints
items.howToConfirm: Shine a Blacklight over doors, windows, walls, and players after the ghost has interacted with objects.
items.confirmTell: Glowing fingerprints or footprints appear under the light. Disturbed salt lines are a reliable place to find them.
items.cardSummary: Prints are revealed with a Blacklight on surfaces the ghost touched. A disturbed salt line is a guaranteed place to check.
items.gotcha: Prints fade after a while, and they fade faster on higher difficulty, so check soon after activity.
items.verificationNote: Fandom V1.10.0: journal label is 'Prints' (former icon name 'Handprints'); revealed with Blacklight; salt-disturbance guarantees prints; fade time scales with difficulty.

items.name: Laser Projector
items.howToConfirm: Place a Laser Projector in the ghost room and watch the laser field, ideally through a Video Camera for clearer detection.
items.confirmTell: The ghost becomes faintly visible as it walks through the laser grid. Lowering Roblox graphics to 1 bar can improve visibility.
items.cardSummary: Laser Projector confirms when the ghost shows up faintly walking through the lasers. A Video Camera and low graphics make it easier to spot.
items.verificationNote: Fandom V1.10.0: ghost slightly visible near laser projector; Video Camera recommended; setting graphics to 1 bar aids visibility.

items.name: Inscription
items.howToConfirm: Place the Spirit Book in the ghost's favorite room and wait, and also watch the walls for markings.
items.confirmTell: Writing appears in the Spirit Book or on walls. If the ghost throws the book outside a hunt, this evidence is disproven.
items.cardSummary: Inscription confirms when the ghost writes in the placed Spirit Book or marks a wall. A book thrown outside a hunt rules it out.
items.verificationNote: Fandom V1.10.0: journal label is 'Inscription' (formerly 'Ghost writing'); found in Spirit Book and on walls; disproven if book is thrown outside a hunt.

items.name: Wither
items.howToConfirm: Watch the map over time for passive decay, and place a Flower Pot in the ghost's room as a clear indicator.
items.confirmTell: Flowers wilt, metal rusts, and paintings distort. The time before decay starts is random.
items.cardSummary: Wither has no detector. Watch for decay over time, and use a placed Flower Pot whose flowers wilt as a clear sign.
items.gotcha: On the prison map, prisoner NPCs can act as a form of Wither evidence.
items.verificationNote: Fandom V1.10.0: passive map decay (wilting flowers, rusting metal, distorted paintings); Flower Pot is the clearest indicator; onset timing is random; prison NPCs act as Wither.
